requirements.text: B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a proven background in software engineering.
Strong hands-on proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or REST APIs.
Direct experience using browser automation frameworks like Playwright, Puppeteer, or BrowserUse along with daily use of AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor or Claude Code.
Ability to look at generated code and workflow structures to ensure maintainability, cleanliness, and system self-healing compatibility.
High EQ and IQ with the communication skills to run technical discovery alongside enterprise executives while maintaining deep technical authority.
